notes: Live UK furniture + home-accessories retailer (Magento backend at mage.barkerandstonehouse.co.uk, Angular Universal storefront, Searchspring-powered category/search grids, siteId zzw53h). Direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF encountered). Home Decor lives under /accessories/*: Lighting, Mirrors, Art (canvas/framed/wall art), Clocks, and flat decorative-accessory leaves (Decorative Objects, Vases, Bowls, Candle Holders, Lanterns, Trays, Pots and Planters). Excluded: Soft Furnishings (cushions/throws/pillows/bedding/duvets - textiles), Rugs (textiles), Artificial Plants (faux-plant exclusion rule), Christmas (holiday/gift), Gift Vouchers (not a product category), Sustainable Accessories/70Off (cross-cutting marketing tags, not taxonomy nodes), and brand-filtered Timothy Oulton / Kartell Lighting & Mirrors pages (facet re-cuts of the same Accessories>Lighting/Mirrors catalogue by brand, not distinct populations - verified against the main categories' own Brand facet). QUANTITY METHOD: cross-checked three independent sources per category - (1) Searchspring category_hierarchy filter pagination.totalResults, (2) exhaustive enumeration of that same query (resultsPerPage=100, paged to completion, unique product `id` values counted - the Rule 1 'cheap proof'), and (3) Magento categoryList.product_count via the public GraphQL endpoint (mage.barkerandstonehouse.co.uk/index.php/graphql), plus live-rendered page text ('N Products' header) fetched via r.jina.ai for spot verification. FINDING: Searchspring's totalResults header is inflated by exactly +1 versus the true exhaustive unique-ID count in every single category tested (16 for 16) - one extra phantom result is counted but never actually returned in the results array. The exhaustive unique-ID count matched the live-rendered 'N Products' page header exactly in every clean read obtained (Table Lamps 89, Floor Lamps 40, Ceiling Lights 71, Wall Lights 15, Full-length Mirrors 3, Wall Mirrors 18, Dressing Table Mirrors 3, Wall Art 13, Canvas Prints 22, Framed Prints 44, Decorative Objects 104, Vases 65, Bowls 5, Candle Holders 8, Lanterns 1, Trays 1, Pots and Planters 2) - so qty below uses the exhaustive unique-ID count, not the raw totalResults header. r.jina.ai was contended (shared across 10 parallel workers) and intermittently returned a stale/corrupted '35 Products' artifact on unrelated URLs; those reads were discarded in favour of the exhaustive-count + Magento cross-check. Rule 0 gain: included Tripod Floor Lamps (a lighting sub-type, currently 0 live SKUs but a real taxonomy node) and a separate Outdoor Lighting node reachable at /garden-furniture/garden-accessories/outdoor-lighting (a distinct nav branch outside /accessories/lighting - documented per Rule 0.6 as a genuine second branch, currently 0 live SKUs, not a duplicate of the Accessories>Lighting count since its product population is disjoint/empty). Clocks/Wall Clocks also kept as a real node at qty 0: Magento's product_count shows 1 (a disabled/out-of-stock SKU) but both the Searchspring exhaustive count and the live-rendered page independently confirm 0 customer-visible products - Magento's count rejected here per the Rule 1 Magento-inflation precedent. Vases and Decorative Objects are real, live, sitemap-indexed catalogue pages that are not linked from the primary mega-menu (found via /sitemap.xml and the Magento category tree) but are genuine product-listing categories, included accordingly.
